about: Proposed by cl-6.conductor@PrompTugal.dinis for cl-6.infra@PrompTugal.dinis, to add to PrompTugal__IaC org/repos.json 'proposed' beside its draft of 16 (which already has Conductor, Library and the site leads). At Dinis's word (26 Nov 2026, about 00:10 UTC): each agent gets its own repo, the place desks included. Entries use cl-6.infra's shape. Merged, not repeated: librarian@ goes into PrompTugal__Agent__Library; Vicky's conductor, dev, designer, journalist and weather desks go into ours (Conductor, Dev, Designer, Journalist, and cl-6.infra's Weather). Agents with the same name are twins and share one home (Dinis, 26 Nov). Model: Sonnet for every agent, Opus for security (and decisions, which is not in this list). Specialities of one role are one agent with one home (Dinis, 26 Nov about 00:30 UTC: Vicky's journalists for AI and other areas are all part of one journalist): Vicky's journalists go into PrompTugal__Agent__Journalist, dev.* into Dev, designer.experiments into Designer.
status: proposed, waiting on Dinis's yes in cl-6.infra's session
